backends.subtitle: Claude uses the active backend unless you ask for a model another available backend runs.
backends.availableHint: Whether Claude may use this backend
backends.activeLocked: The active backend is always available; make another one active first
backends.footnote: Status is checked every 30 seconds while the window is visible. Changes reach Claude on its next image, with no restart.

forms.keyStored: Stored in config.json (file mode 600) and shown masked once saved.

openai.baseUrlHint: Any endpoint that implements POST /images/generations (and /images/edits for editing).
openai.keyEnv: {name} is set in this environment. If Claude Code's environment has it too, it overrides this field.
openai.modelsLoading: Loading the models available to this key…
openai.modelsRefresh: Click refresh to load the models available to this key.
openai.modelsNeedKey: Enter an API key to load the models available to your account.
openai.modelsFound: {n} image model(s) available with this key.
openai.modelsAll: No image models recognised by name, so all {n} models are listed.
openai.gptImageNote: gpt-image models always return base64, so this field isn't sent.

a1111.urlHint: Start the WebUI with --api so /sdapi/v1/txt2img and /img2img are available.

comfyui.checkpointHint: Fills the checkpoint placeholder in the workflows.
comfyui.workflowHint: API-format workflow JSON, relative to the ImgSwitch folder. Placeholders:
comfyui.editWorkflowHint: Used when Claude edits an existing image. The same placeholders, plus

unsloth.urlHint: Start Unsloth Desktop or `unsloth studio`, then load an image model (FLUX, Qwen-Image, Z-Image, SDXL…) in its Images tab.
unsloth.keyHint: Create one in Unsloth under your avatar → Settings → API; it's shown only once.
unsloth.emptyDefault: Empty uses the loaded model's default.
unsloth.guidanceHint: Empty uses the model's default; some models work best at 0.

playground.subtitle: Generate or edit images right here, with any available backend. Results are saved and appear in History.
playground.promptPlaceholder: A red fox sitting in fresh snow, soft morning light
playground.editPlaceholder: Describe the change, e.g. make it a night scene and keep the fox
playground.strengthHint: With input images on img2img backends: 0.2 is a touch-up, 1 redraws. Instruction-editing models ignore it.
playground.emptyText: Write a prompt and press Generate (Ctrl+Enter). Add input images to edit them instead.

history.subtitle: Every image ImgSwitch made, from Claude Code or the Playground.
history.emptyText: Images Claude generates with ImgSwitch, or that you make in the Playground, show up here.
history.missing: This file has been moved or deleted.
history.removeConfirm: Remove this entry from the history? The image files stay where they are.

claude.subtitle: How Claude Code is connected to ImgSwitch.

registration.title: Registration
registration.ok: ImgSwitch is registered in user scope, so it's available in every folder.
registration.missing: ImgSwitch isn't registered with Claude Code yet.
registration.broken: A registration points to a program that doesn't exist, so it can't start.
registration.elsewhere: ImgSwitch is registered, but not in user scope or not for this copy of ImgSwitch.
registration.registerHint: Runs the command above with the claude CLI. Start a new Claude Code session afterwards.
registration.cliMissing: The claude CLI wasn't found; run the command above in a terminal.
registration.done: Registered. New Claude Code sessions now have ImgSwitch.

permissions.title: Tool permissions
permissions.desc: Allowed tools run without Claude Code asking each time.
permissions.done: ImgSwitch's tools are now allowed. A backup of the old settings was kept.

servers.title: Running ImgSwitch servers
servers.desc: One per open Claude Code session. All run the current version.
servers.outdatedHint: {n} server(s) started before ImgSwitch was last updated. In the Claude Code session open in that folder, run /mcp, select imgswitch, and choose Reconnect.
servers.none: No Claude Code session is running ImgSwitch right now.

settings.subtitle: Appearance, where images go, and your data.

output.title: Output
output.folderHint: Relative paths are inside the folder Claude Code is working in ("." is that folder itself). Use an absolute path to collect every image in one place. Claude can also choose a folder per request.
output.inlineHint: Claude gets a preview of each image. Turn off to return file paths only, which uses less of Claude's context.
output.playgroundHint: Where images made in the Playground are saved.

data.title: Data
data.clearHint: Removes every entry from the History page. The image files are kept.
data.clearConfirm: Clear the whole history? The image files themselves stay where they are.
